title: Doped, heated silicon in a PEC guide: plasma dispersion + thermo-optic index sum on em_modes (analytic)
description:
The PEC guide of analytic_modes_soref_bennett_guide (em_modes, mode_analysis at 1.55 um, 52 x 27 uniform 20 nm cells: a = 1.0 um, b = 0.5 um between the wall planes) filled with library silicon (thermal expansion set to 0, no dispersion), now with two background physics: drift_diffusion (uniform signed doping N_net, one ohmic contact: uniform neutral equilibrium) and steady heat (every outer face at T0 + dT: uniform dT = 25 K). semiconductor_em_plasma_dispersion (dn = -(a N + b P^0.8), Soref-Bennett silicon) and heat_em_thermo_optic (dndT dT) are two E13 index contributors summed on the em_modes permittivity slots, and sigma_e is a state-dependent material expression of semiconductor_N / semiconductor_P (Soref-Bennett free-carrier absorption, sigma_e = n0 alpha eps0 c). Sweep N_net = -1e25..1e25 1/m^3 (holes left, electrons right).
Analytic: N = |N_net| / 2 + sqrt(N_net^2 / 4 + n_i^2) for n type (P = n_i^2 / N), mirrored for p type; n = n0 + dndT dT - (a N + b P^0.8) (the thermo-optic +4.5e-3 against up to -1.3e-2 of 1e25 holes: the total dn changes sign between 1e24 and 3e24 holes and near 5e24 electrons); homogeneous complex fill, discrete TE10: n_eff^2 = A - j B, A = n^2 - (K / k0)^2, K = (2 / h) sin(pi h / (2 a)), B = sigma_e / (omega eps0) = n0 alpha / k0; Re n_eff = sqrt((hypot(A, B) + A) / 2), Im n_eff = -B / (2 Re n_eff), loss in dB/cm.
Derived values tab: n_eff_1 (~1e-6), n_eff_imag_1 / loss_1 (~1e-5), dn_total = mean sqrt(eps_r) - n0 (the index sum; float32 eps_r ~1e-7 absolute, tolerance 1e-3 relative), sigma_fill (the state-dependent sigma_e, ~1e-6), N_mean (equilibrium, ~1e-7) and T_rise_mean (exact uniform rise, ~1e-9).
Sweep tab: n_eff_1, loss_1 and dn_total vs N_net with their dashed curves. Line profile tab: sz_profile = S_z of the 1 W TE10 mode across x at mid-height, 2 / (a b) sin^2(pi (x - h) / a) (W/m^2, independent of the fill).

parameters.name: N_net
parameters.description: signed net doping in 1/m^3: > 0 donors (n type), < 0 acceptors (p type); the sweep runs -1e25..1e25 (base = its last value)

parameters.name: dT
parameters.description: uniform temperature rise in K (heat faces held at T0 + dT)

parameters.name: T0
parameters.description: heat T0: the thermo-optic reference temperature in K

parameters.name: n_si
parameters.description: undoped silicon index n0 at 1.55 um (eps_r = n_si^2)

parameters.name: dndT_si
parameters.description: thermo-optic coefficient of silicon in 1/K

parameters.name: n_i
parameters.description: intrinsic carrier density in 1/m^3

parameters.name: a_sb
parameters.description: electron coefficient of dn in m^3 (Soref-Bennett 8.8e-22 cm^3)

parameters.name: b_sb
parameters.description: hole coefficient of dn in m^2.4 (1.347e-22)

parameters.name: c_sb
parameters.description: hole exponent of dn

parameters.name: lambda0
parameters.description: vacuum wavelength of the mode solve

parameters.name: k_vac
parameters.description: vacuum wavenumber k0 in 1/m

parameters.name: h_cell
parameters.description: uniform cell size

parameters.name: a_guide
parameters.description: guide width between the x wall planes (1.0 um)

parameters.name: b_guide
parameters.description: guide height between the y wall planes (0.5 um)

parameters.name: w_contact
parameters.description: ohmic contact width at the x_lo end (two cell columns)

parameters.name: N_maj
parameters.description: majority carrier density in 1/m^3

parameters.name: N_min
parameters.description: minority carrier density in 1/m^3 (mass action)

parameters.name: N0
parameters.description: analytic electron density in 1/m^3

parameters.name: P0
parameters.description: analytic hole density in 1/m^3

parameters.name: dn_plasma
parameters.description: analytic plasma-dispersion index change

parameters.name: dn_thermal
parameters.description: analytic thermo-optic index change (+4.5e-3)

parameters.name: n_ref
parameters.description: analytic index of the doped, heated silicon (E13 index sum)

parameters.name: alpha_ref
parameters.description: Soref-Bennett free-carrier power absorption in 1/m

parameters.name: sigma_ref
parameters.description: analytic sigma_e of the fill in S/m

parameters.name: K_te10
parameters.description: discrete transverse wavenumber of TE10 in 1/m

parameters.name: A_re
parameters.description: Re n_eff^2 of TE10

parameters.name: B_im
parameters.description: -Im n_eff^2 = sigma_e / (omega eps0)

parameters.name: n_eff_ref
parameters.description: analytic Re n_eff of TE10

parameters.name: n_eff_imag_ref
parameters.description: analytic Im n_eff of TE10 (< 0: loss)

parameters.name: loss_ref
parameters.description: analytic modal power loss in dB/cm
